room.note: LoadImage expects a filename inside the ComfyUI input folder (upload first). Feeds VAEEncode 239 -> ReferenceLatent 229 'ROOM' used by the character sampler 350. Group 'Load Room images' (nodes 236/238/240 and VAEEncodes 237/239/241) is bypassed (mode 4) in the shipped file: set 238 and 239 to mode 0 to use a supplied room. Otherwise the room is generated from the description in CLIPTextEncode 343.

prompt.note: Character/action text; concatenated by StringConcatenate 179 with node 180 (bypassed) into CLIPTextEncode 169.

image.note: Character placed in the room (sampler 350). Room-only outputs: SaveImage 339 (base room) and 291, 364, 365, 366, 367 (room angles); SaveImage 369 is the bypassed face-detailer pass.

unknown: image: the character identity comes from a trained LoRA (LoraLoaderModelOnly 361, title 'CHARACTER LORA (TRAIN YOUR OWN)'), not from an image; there is no character image loader in this workflow.
notes: LoadImage 363 'Room for angles' is not wired to anything.
Angle prompts live in CLIPTextEncode 307, 314, 322, 327, 359 (mis-titled 'Negative Prompt').
Base-room text: CLIPTextEncode 343 (Klein path); the QWEN base-room group is bypassed.
